component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() for each id in ["under", "over", "list", "mlist"] root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for i = 0 to 7 root.createChild("ContentNode").title = StrI(i).trim() end for m.top.findNode(id).content = root end for m.top.findNode("under").setFocus(true) end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean ' Down/Up swap focus between the two grids. ' Play focuses the LabelList, Options the MarkupList, Down/Up the two grids. if press and key = "play" m.top.findNode("list").setFocus(true) return true else if press and key = "options" m.top.findNode("mlist").setFocus(true) return true else if press and key = "down" m.top.findNode("over").setFocus(true) return true else if press and key = "up" m.top.findNode("under").setFocus(true) return true end if return false end function
